title: Kim Scott: 'one of the most important books of the decade'
summary: Radical Candor author Kim Scott posts a fresh public endorsement on LinkedIn — her third on-the-record signal for Incorruptible (after the original book blurb and her Radical Candor podcast episode). Framed for leaders, not just founders.
blockquote: Eric Ries's new book Incorruptible is one of the most important books of the decade. If you are a leader committed to doing good things in a flawed world, this is your guide.
attribution_title: Co-founder of Radical Candor; NYT Bestselling Author of Radical Candor & Radical Respect
